newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas nears sale to Lufthansa - report.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas nears sale to Lufthansa - report.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp is near an agreement with Deutsche Lufthansa AG to sell up to 12 MD-11 cargo jets to the German carrier in a deal that could be worth $1.3 billion, The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
Lufthansa is said to be placing firm orders for five planes valued at about $545 million, and securing future options to buy seven more of the three-engine jumbo jets.
McDonnell Douglas has not received a sizable MD-11 order from a big-name carrier in more than a year.

For much of the last three years, McDonnell's chief executive, Harry Stonecipher, has been working to persuade the world's airlines that McDonnell has overcome its problems in the commercial jetliner business.

A McDonnell spokesman declined to comment on the anticipated MD-11 order. But sources familiar with the talks said an agreement could be announced before Britain's Farnborough International Air Show concludes this week.
